description: Individual incremental balancing energy bids (Historical data - up to 22/05/2024) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. This report contains data for the last 2 years and is refreshed once per day. Individual anonymized available incremental volumes and corresponding prices based on automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve (aFRR) and manual Frequency Restoration Reserve (mFRR)energy bids and nominations both day-ahead and intraday - submitted by Balance responsible Parties (BRPs) and Balance Service Providers (BSPs) ... Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Availibility. The portal shows 2024-08-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
